expert.finding: The top banner states bookings are available Saturdays through December, but there is no calendar or date picker on this homepage to confirm next Saturday's availability.
expert.suggestion: Add a visible date selector or availability indicator on the homepage so users can verify next Saturday afternoon before clicking through.

expert.finding: The progress indicator at the top shows step 1 'SERVICE' as active, but provides no confirmation that a service has been selected after clicking any of the 'Select' buttons.
expert.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., highlight the selected service card or show a confirmation message) immediately after a user clicks 'Select'.

expert.finding: There is no way to filter or sort services by duration or price, making it difficult for a user booking a haircut for next Saturday afternoon to quickly find appropriately timed options.
expert.suggestion: Add filter controls for duration and price range above the service list.

expert.finding: The date grid shows 'Sat 24' as selectable, but the time grid below is labeled 'Available times · Tuesday 20 October', so users cannot see Saturday's slots and may think the date is broken.
expert.suggestion: When a date is tapped, immediately load and display that date's available times and update the subheading to match the selected date.

expert.finding: The 'Continue' button is visible but disabled with no message explaining that a time must be selected first, so users may tap it repeatedly and wonder why nothing happens.
expert.suggestion: Keep the button disabled but add inline helper text such as 'Please select a time to continue' near the time grid or button.

expert.finding: The progress indicator shows step 3 'YOUR DETAILS' as active, but the page title and heading say 'Create an account', creating ambiguity about whether the user is booking or registering.
expert.suggestion: Align the step label with the page purpose, e.g. change step 3 to 'ACCOUNT DETAILS' or rename the page to 'Your details'.

expert.finding: The marketing checkbox 'Send me offers, events and seasonal news from Marlowe Studio.' is pre-checked, which can lead to unintended opt-in and form submission errors.
expert.suggestion: Uncheck the marketing checkbox by default so users actively consent.

expert.finding: The confirmation states 'We've sent a confirmation to amara@example.com' but provides no visual status indicator (e.g., sent, delivered, failed) or way to resend if the email never arrives.
expert.suggestion: Add a clear status badge such as 'Confirmation sent' and a 'Resend confirmation' link.

expert.finding: The price is listed as 'from $68 (confirmed at your consultation)', leaving the final cost uncertain at the moment of booking.
expert.suggestion: Display the confirmed total price for this appointment instead of a starting price.

expert.finding: A control has no accessible name, so screen readers announce just "button".
expert.suggestion: Give icon-only buttons an aria-label (e.g. aria-label="Close") or visible text.

expert.finding: Low-contrast text (“Sun 25 Closed”; “Mon 26 Closed”; “10:00” +20 more). Measured: 2.9:1 (needs 4.5:1).
expert.suggestion: Darken the text or lighten the background to reach at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).

expert.finding: Tap target (“Marlowe Studio”; “Change service”; “10:00” +24 more) is smaller than 40×40 px on a phone. Measured: 151×26px.
expert.suggestion: Make interactive elements at least 44×44 px (min-height/min-width or padding).

expert.finding: Multiple navigation links and buttons all point to services.html with generic labels like 'Book now', 'Book an appointment', and 'Book a cut', forcing users to remember which entry point they used.
expert.suggestion: Differentiate primary calls to action with distinct, context-specific labels such as 'Book a haircut' versus 'Book colour' to match the user's goal.

expert.finding: All ten 'Select' buttons have identical accessible names, so keyboard and screen-reader users cannot distinguish which service each button controls.
expert.suggestion: Give each 'Select' button a unique accessible name that includes the service title, e.g., 'Select Signature Cut & Finish'.

expert.finding: The stylist dropdown is set to 'Any available stylist' and requires an extra click to filter by a specific stylist, which slows down users who already know who they want.
expert.suggestion: Add stylist filter chips above the date grid so users can jump directly to a preferred stylist without opening the dropdown.

expert.finding: Disabled time slots (e.g., 10:00, 16:30) are shown greyed out with no reason, so users must guess whether they are closed, booked, or outside opening hours.
expert.suggestion: Add a tooltip or small label on disabled slots explaining why they are unavailable, such as 'Closed' or 'Fully booked'.

expert.finding: The Date of birth field shows placeholder 'DD/MM/YYYY' but no inline hint about acceptable formats or age restrictions, forcing users to guess or discover errors after submission.
expert.suggestion: Add a visible format hint below the Date of birth input, such as 'Must be 16 or older'.

expert.finding: The 'Add to calendar' button offers no choice of calendar application or file format (e.g., .ics, Google Calendar, Outlook).
expert.suggestion: Provide a dropdown or multiple options so users can add the booking to their preferred calendar.

expert.finding: The reference code 'MS-4818' is shown without explaining where or how the user might need to use it (e.g., at check-in or when contacting support).
expert.suggestion: Add a short helper line such as 'Quote this reference at the studio or when contacting us.'

expert.finding: Low-contrast text (“From our guest book, September”; “M”). Measured: 3.2:1 (needs 4.5:1).
expert.suggestion: Darken the text or lighten the background to reach at least 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text).
